brief:
Settlers launched an attack on residential homes in Kisan village, located east of Bethlehem, on Tuesday evening, Shehab Wire reported. During the raid, the assailants attempted to steal sheep belonging to residents of the Palestinian community.

The incident marks another instance of settler violence targeting Palestinian civilians and their property in the occupied West Bank. No immediate reports detailed the extent of damage to homes or whether residents sustained injuries in the confrontation.
